history.content: got passed over for the lead role again. third time. didnt even tell me to my face
That sounds like a sharp kind of being passed over, and the part about not being told to your face makes it feel even colder.
its not really hurt. more like. i dont know. they keep acting like im not lead material and its bs
I had that wrong. It sounds closer to anger, maybe frustration, with a sting of being dismissed, and I won't call it hurt unless that fits for you.
frustration yeah. ive been there 6 yrs. trained half the people who keep getting picked over me. they brought in some guy from outside for it

Yeah, that kind of frustration makes sense here, especially with six years in and having trained people who keep getting chosen instead. It sounds like the part that gets hit is being overlooked or not treated as the obvious fit.
the worst part is i started wondering if theyre right. like maybe theres something about me that screams not good enough. and then im furious i even think that

That’s a nasty loop, the doubt turns inward and then the fury comes up at even having the doubt. I’m wondering if the anger is doing some defending there, or if it feels more like self-directed shame too?
ya i guess the anger is easier. if im angry at them then its their fault not mine. but theres this quiet voice that says maybe youre just not it
That makes sense, the anger is easier to hold than that quieter doubt. I’m learning this has a protective edge, with the harsher voice sitting underneath it.
the guy they hired is younger than me. and i sat in the meeting and smiled and said congrats. felt like i was choking on it
That sounds like a hard swallow, smiling while something in you was tightening up. Was it more resentment, humiliation, or just that choking, held-in feeling?
all of it. mostly i keep replaying every time ive been overlooked and stacking it up. like proof. like see, this is who you are to them
That lands as more than the meeting, it’s all those past overlooks turning into “proof.” I’m wondering if the moment meant, to you, that they see you as less than you are?
yeah. that they see me as less. i think i wanted someone to just say it wasnt fair without telling me to network more or whatever
Yeah, wanting someone to just say it wasn’t fair makes a lot of sense. I can leave it here, or stay with that part if you want.
yeah leave it here. that actually helped a bit. thanks
Of course, I’m glad it helped a little. Take care of yourself tonight.
